title_en: The Expected Mahdi in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim - Episode 2
description_en: The Expected Mahdi in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim - Episode 2, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode examining references to the expected Mahdi in the two primary Sunni hadith collections, Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
